name: Sunbeams is a native cast-time modifier on Radiant Cascade only (#3694)
contract: Spell.dbc 807874 ("Sunbeams", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) has one SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effect with EffectMiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), EffectBasePoints -16 (amount -15), and EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 32768, which a repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for family-33 spells shows matches only the Radiant Cascade chain. Player::ApplySpellMod's CASTING_TIME/DURATION branch (Player.cpp:10219) computes basevalue = (basevalue+totalflat)*totalmul; with no flat modifier and a single -15% pct modifier, totalmul = 0.85, so base 1000 reads back 850 — the tooltip's 'reduces the cast time of Radiant Cascade by 15%'. This is a fully generic native pipeline; no server script exists or is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sanity: no cast-time modifier on Radiant Cascade before learning
Radiant Cascade's cast time is reduced by 15%
An unrelated family-33 spell (Gavel of Light) keeps its normal cast time
